module.purpose: Defines the complete schema factory and default schema configurations for tldraw records, shapes, bindings, assets, users, and custom records.
module.summary: This module assembles the persistent tldraw data model from built-in and caller-provided schema fragments. It collects style properties, creates record types, rejects custom record names that conflict with built-ins, and combines core, property-specific, custom, and caller-supplied migrations into a validated store schema.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative drawing documents by defining and evolving their persisted records. Failure prevents stores from validating, migrating, or safely loading tldraw content.

UserSchemaInfo (~L213-225): Optional custom user metadata and migration configuration

systemCapabilities: Register built-in and custom record types

detail.signature:
export function createTLSchema({
	shapes = defaultShapeSchemas,
	bindings = defaultBindingSchemas,
	assets = defaultAssetSchemas,
	user,
	records = {},
	migrations,
}: {
	shapes?: Record<string, SchemaPropsInfo>
	bindings?: Record<string, SchemaPropsInfo>
	assets?: Record<string, SchemaPropsInfo>
	user?: UserSchemaInfo
	records?: Record<string, CustomRecordInfo>
	migrations?: readonly MigrationSequence[]
} = {}): TLSchema
preconditions: The optional shapes, bindings, assets, user, records, and migrations arguments must conform to their declared TypeScript types.
Custom record names must not be built-in record type names.
postconditions: Returns a TLSchema created from the supplied or default record schemas.
Shape styles are collected into a style-id map and used to create the instance record type.
Each configured custom record has a corresponding custom record type in the resulting schema.
invariants: A style id maps to only one StyleProp instance across all supplied shape schemas.
Built-in record type names cannot be used for custom records.
When user schema metadata is omitted, the default UserRecordType is used.
edgeCases: With no argument or omitted optional collections, default shape, binding, and asset schemas are used, records defaults to an empty object, and the default user record type is used.
If two distinct StyleProp instances share an id across the supplied shape schemas, the function throws an Error.
If a custom record name is one of the built-in record names, the function throws an Error instead of creating the schema.
An empty custom-record collection creates no custom record types.
